steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ say what normally happens around you — I work in a pedestrian area
✓ say what is happening at this moment — Today I’m working from 7 to 3
✓ use both tenses in one description of the same place
✓ make negatives and questions in both — Does he work alone? Are you working today?
✓ keep state verbs simple — I know everyone , not I’m knowing
✓ name what is in a street — market place, stall, statue, tower block, parking space
